methods.title: STAMPED research-object rubric
methods.description: Fixed manuscript-derived 36-criterion rubric with normalized dimension scores, configurable dimension weights, and independent reviewer contributions.

scales.overall: Weighted mean of seven dimensions; equal weights by default
scales.missing: null remains unanswered and contributes zero to provisional score; no discretionary denominator exclusion

methods.evidence_policy: Start at the declared object and follow explicit references. Preserve discovery paths and distinguish observed, absent, not_findable, inaccessible and not_assessed. Evidence ratings and confidence are optional and do not change scores.
native_outputs: seven dimension scores and weighted total
methods.review_model: Separate assessment contributions with reviewer identity and review_of link; no automatic consensus.
caveats: A numeric total summarizes the declared rubric and weights, not general scientific quality.
No native assessor SKILL.md; use the assessment protocol plus exact rubric.

methods.title: STAMPED use-case assessment framework
methods.description: Versioned use-case rubrics, activity-based evidence records, categorical judgments, and digest-bound reviews. The repository is infrastructure, not an assessor skill or universal rubric.
methods.license: MIT (code); CC-BY-4.0 (schemas, documentation, records and vendored references)
methods.evidence_policy: A positive judgment requires every criterion-required activity to have evidence. Activity completion, successful reproduction, finalization and scope completion are separate. Access barriers require an observed barrier, not an unattempted action.
methods.review_model: Independent review records reference the semantic SHA-256 of an assessment; dispositions agree, disagree or needs_evidence; optional suggested categorical status.

proposed_assessor.runtime_difference: Requested framework HEAD adds only README link and docs/automation-evidence.md; executable code, schema and bundled pilot are unchanged.
proposed_assessor.selection_status: Documented background candidate only; not selected for this experiment.

caveats: Bundled paper-handoff rubric has seven narrow manuscript criteria; it is not a general research-object assessment.
The intended upstream skill repository default branch only contains an earlier intervention-oriented draft. The concrete assessor is on an explicitly identified fork.
Use-case rubric creation and selected priorities are an instrument-design factor, not assessor-independent constants.
methods.selection_status: Excluded from this experiment by user decision; retained as background comparison only.

methods.title: CON checklist assessor: implementation branch
methods.description: Probe-assisted assessment of committed project state against all 31 pinned checklist items, with five verdict states and actionable findings.
methods.license: MIT (scripts); unspecified/TBD (repository skill prose); upstream CC-BY-4.0 (vendored checklist)

scales.summary: Counts by MUST/SHOULD/MAY with denominators; partial never satisfies MUST; unknowns and N/A remain visible

methods.evidence_policy: Run applicable probes, inspect their evidence, judge remaining items, and preserve overrides or questioned mappings. met requires a citation; unmet requires evidence of absence. Reasons are limited to 250 characters; richer argument lives in evidence entries.
methods.review_model: Instructions call for framework records for evaluation/review but supply no native response-to-framework exporter; any study adapter must be explicit and validated.
caveats: No overall score is native or permitted by the report instructions.
Both branches retain skill version 0.1.0; full commit pins are essential.
Checklist omits licensing items and T.4; these are extras, and must/014 duplicates should/008.
App URLs omit richer status, evidence and reviewer metadata; preserve original response JSON.
Fresh workflow definitions can be accepted as equivalent freshness evidence in instructions; later branch requires completed-run evidence.
Environment probe conflates dependency pinning with completeness and can over-credit a responding remote or annex location log.
Inspect-only boundary conflicts with fallback instruction to edit .gitignore when external output is unavailable; study must provide external output.
methods.boundary_policy: Only committed state counts; dirty working tree is reported but excluded from assessed state.

methods.title: CON checklist assessor: research-guidance branch
methods.description: Probe-assisted 31-item checklist assessment with delivered-state capture, explicit equivalent evidence, stronger retrieval and completed-execution checks, and more conservative probe interpretations.
methods.license: MIT (scripts); unspecified/TBD (repository skill prose); upstream CC-BY-4.0 (vendored checklist)

scales.summary: Counts by MUST/SHOULD/MAY with denominators; partial never satisfies MUST; unknowns and N/A remain visible

methods.evidence_policy: Run applicable probes, inspect their evidence, judge remaining items, and preserve overrides or questioned mappings. met requires a citation; unmet requires evidence of absence. Reasons are limited to 250 characters; richer argument lives in evidence entries.
methods.review_model: Probe-versus-judgment differences retained through flags; response JSON is canonical. Keep external review records separate in the comparison study.
caveats: No overall score is native or permitted by the report instructions.
Both branches retain skill version 0.1.0; full commit pins are essential.
Checklist omits licensing items and T.4; these are extras, and must/014 duplicates should/008.
App URLs omit richer status, evidence and reviewer metadata; preserve original response JSON.
Declared instructions differ from underlying Git-path probes; assessor must inspect evidence outside probe representations.
Retrieval claims require exact-version payload access evidence; lower met counts can reflect a stricter evidence threshold rather than a worse object.
Framework export only required when calling harness provides pinned export schemas.
methods.boundary_policy: Assess declared delivered bytes, including uncommitted/ignored artifacts and capture omissions; distinguish worker state from later coordinator preservation. URL capture still only establishes the named public revision.

background_sources.title: STAMPED in Practice
background_sources.description: Prior adaptive NARPS research-guidance experiment; informs study design, not an additional assessment arm.
